en: Black‑and‑white view of a grand European boulevard or square lined with ornate late‑19th‑century apartment buildings. The central building is on a street corner with a rounded façade, multiple balconies and a tall tower-like cupola. Similar richly decorated façades with bay windows and wrought-iron balconies continue along both streets. In the foreground are a few pedestrians, a horse‑drawn carriage, small carts, gas‑style streetlamps and young trees planted along the sidewalk, giving the impression of an affluent urban neighborhood from the turn of the 20th century. No visible caption or border text is present on the image side.
